reviews.text: Spectacular service, super professional!!
I took my kitten to get neutered, and they closed him up wrong and gave him so much anesthesia that they almost killed him.

The best vet the neighborhood could have ever had. Incredibly dedicated, we've never seen a professional like him. Our dog is a real handful, and he always sees us, even outside of regular hours. He advises you on the best treatment; you can tell it's his passion, not just a business.
It's nothing like the clinic used to be, when Pablo ran it and then Nacho. Before, it was a close-knit, family atmosphere; now it's just another business...
When Pablo was here, things worked, even in the ER he'd find a spot. Now it's a disgrace. We miss you so much, Pablo, we hope you come back.

On Friday, April 17th, I was at the clinic and was attended to at reception by a rather elderly woman with short hair. She provided terrible service, treating clients badly and giving rude answers to our questions. She refused to give me an appointment for my pet even though I was standing right there in front of her. She told me I had to send a WhatsApp message to request an appointment. I don't know why she makes things so difficult when it can be avoided. Other times I've been given an appointment without needing to send a WhatsApp message. In short, I left the clinic without an appointment because of that woman's whims. I think it's awful, and that's not even mentioning the rude answers she gives to clients. The veterinarian on the afternoon shift is a sweetheart with the animals; she's the best doctor and very good at her job. I hope she continues to be so.

They abandoned me with my sick rabbit after years of treatment. They told me they were no longer exotic pets. They should have notified me when they stopped treating exotic animals so I could find another vet. And on top of that, they haven't given me my rabbit's medical records so she can be treated properly elsewhere. It's a disgrace. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone. Heartless people. I wish they could experience the pain of having a sick pet and not treat someone as badly as they treated me. I will never go back, even if I get another pet.

We took our dog in for an aural hematoma, and instead of curing her, they made things worse. Now, after her supposed cure, the dog is better.
Of course, we won't be going back so they can kill our dog, and I'll think very carefully about filing a complaint. It's unbelievable that places like this can be open.
Thanks to the doctor. They saved our cat. No additional medication was prescribed. Thank you so much.

I recently took my cat to be spayed and everything was perfect. Everyone was wonderful, and my kitten recovered very quickly. I also took her to get her microchipped, and that went wonderfully too. This has definitely become my pet's trusted vet. 100% recommended

This clinic changed vets. I'm sorry, the new one doesn't inspire any confidence at all. It's ridiculous that she told me I have to give my cat a pill so she can give her a vaccine. She was scared just because she touched her with her claws. And she's supposed to be a professional.

This veterinary clinic has several significant limitations to consider before purchasing their insurance.

The insurance requires you to go exclusively to this clinic, with no option to visit other centers. They only have one clinic in Barcelona, ​​which is problematic in emergencies or when there is no availability. Furthermore, in more serious cases, they refer you to external hospitals without any agreement with your insurance, rendering the insurance useless in that situation.

For a vaccination appointment, we arrived on the scheduled day and time, but upon arrival, we were informed that they did not have the necessary vaccine and had to return another day. I believe that if they lack the necessary supplies, it would be appropriate to notify you in advance to avoid unnecessary trips.

Our pet has chronic dermatitis and frequently experiences visible allergic reactions. During the visit, no further assessment was performed beyond administering the vaccine.

There is no active follow-up: no reminders for checkups, deworming, or regular monitoring, nor is there any communication via WhatsApp or other means. The only notification we received was an annual SMS for insurance renewal, which gives the impression that communication focuses primarily on financial matters.

Given the lack of follow-up and interest in the animal's progress, we were forced to go to another veterinarian, whom we still see today, and who does meet these basic requirements.

Finally, the elderly woman at reception is very slow, sometimes lengthening waiting times.

In short, it may be useful for very basic procedures, but the closed insurance system, the lack of follow-up, and some organizational issues mean it's neither a flexible nor a comprehensive option for ongoing veterinary care.
I switched to this vet on a recommendation, and everything is great, although I don't live nearby, it's worth the trip.
Excellent service, the staff there are very friendly 😃 …
Several visits with my 2 cats. We have received excellent and very professional care. They have treated them with great care and continue to care for them after the visits.
The best vet! I live 40 minutes away and I still go because my cat deserves the quality of life and top-notch care they offer. Thank you! ❤️❤️✨✨✨
Excellent service and genuine love for animals, thank you so much!

I've had my cats spayed and everything went very well. I even took my cat Mar for a checkup and they did urine and blood tests and treated her very well. I'm very happy with the veterinarians and the excellent service they provided.
Thank you for taking care of the animals too.

It was awful, seriously, don't go. They've changed owners, and even if you ask, they won't tell you. They don't have the information; they've deleted it. The vet didn't seem professional at all, seriously. It was like something out of a movie. Plus, it's like you ask her a question, and she takes ages to answer. She recommended an expensive test, I had it done, and then, when the specialist came, it turned out it wasn't necessary because it was just a morphological test—meaning the vet didn't have the necessary knowledge. I don't understand the lack of professionalism in such a serious field. I'm sorry, but you don't play around with our pets, and I'm not going to stay silent.
Emergency care with excellent professionals. Traveling the world and studying @keziatavaresbtasilitalia

It was my first time there and I was very satisfied. They treated my puppy very well.
And they gave me a lot of information and advice.
My almost 14-year-old dog had surgery to remove some skin tumors, and it all went quickly and well. Highly recommended! 👍 …

Our two cats were spayed on Tuesday, everything went perfectly, and M Carmen was there to help us every step of the way.

We are so grateful.
Very good care for my cat, they cut his nails and he didn't even move, very happy.
Today I took my two adopted kittens for their first visit and they were lovely. The kittens didn't even notice the vaccines and the chip. We will definitely be back.
Perfect. Recommended.

We took our cat to be spayed six days ago and we couldn't be happier. The procedure and recovery went very well. We're very pleased with the veterinary clinic. Thank you so much for the wonderful care you gave both Mia and us.
We took our kitten Mia to be spayed on 22/07 and everything went great, thanks to the surgeon Michael and the whole team ☺️
We took our cat to be spayed yesterday, and everything was great. The staff were fantastic; you can tell they love animals. Thank you so much for treating Lola so well.

Great service, perfect value for money.
I recommend it.

The castration surgeries are performed by another veterinarian, a male surgeon who specializes exclusively in this procedure. We're happy with this specialist; everything went very well, without any problems, and the recovery was quick. 😸🙂 Thank you. …
They're great with dogs, and they're also affiliated with several insurance companies. Very nice. Highly recommended.
Very attentive and good professionals
Both the receptionist and the vet were very friendly!

Nacho is the most caring vet I have ever met. Also very affordable compared to many others (I price compared in the beginning). He helped me through the senior years of my old dog, and now also with my new dog, since we rescued her. I travel 30 minutes just to see him and I recommend him to all my friends. Everyone feels the same. You can really tell he cares. 5 stars

I have been using the clinic for my dog ​​and cat for years and I am extremely satisfied! They operated on Nazar and I have all my checkups there and everything is up to standard! I am satisfied with the staff - very kind and bright people! I recommend! 😊 …

I just went to the clinic and I'm very happy. They treated me well, they took great care of the kitten before and after the endoscopy, and they gave me a good explanation about his condition and treatment. I recommend this clinic.
Thank you very much Pablo, both for taking care of my kittens and for the treatment I received!

Very professional, friendly, and sincere. The experience and veterinary knowledge of the staff is evident; they treated Cosmo very well. We had a somewhat delicate endoscopy, and everything went perfectly. Thank you so much!

Excellent service! I took my furry friend to be neutered and he was back with me in less than two hours. The two women were very friendly and explained everything very well 😊. My dog ​​left happy, and so was I! …

I'm so grateful to this clinic, it's wonderful!
They're always attentive and the service is excellent.
I went because my dog ​​had an ear infection and thanks to them he's perfectly fine now.
I'll be back a thousand times over. Thank you, family! ♥️

I took my Border Collie in for stomach problems. The treatment was fantastic, the staff were wonderful. The treatment they prescribed helped him recover very quickly, and now he's doing great. Thank you for your care and professionalism. You've become my trusted veterinary clinic.
A very good experience. They were very kind to my dog. They solved my problem. I will definitely return. Thank you so much for everything.
They are very professional and very caring with their patients.
The best, thank you, you saved my furry friend's life

The worst experience ever at a clinic I'd always gone to... and the new "vets" were a disgrace. Rest in peace, sweetheart. You had so much more to live.

"Take him for 30 days" is a lie. I went on a Thursday and sent videos of how the cat was doing starting on Sunday.

In response to Pablo's review, I didn't go 30 days without taking the cat in. It was one week, plus another week it took you to schedule an appointment. And then another week of you giving me the runaround, saying the cat was fine.

A terrible experience.

My partner went with a valid prescription for our adopted puppy, who needs parasite treatment, and the service was absolutely appalling. They refused to sell her the medication and simply told her to go somewhere else.

Zero empathy, zero professionalism, and a rude attitude. Even a customer who was there was shocked by the treatment and recommended another vet, where they treated her without any problems.

It's a shame that a place that's supposed to care for animal welfare acts this way.

I don't plan to return or recommend this place to anyone.
Highly professional
Slow, very slow, the receptionist takes forever to respond

I took my cat to the clinic for a kidney problem, and Dr. Clara saw her. It's clear she has a lot of experience.
My cat, despite being 18 years old, is much better now.
I'm so grateful to Dr. Clara for the professional and caring attention she gave my cat. She took the time to explain everything clearly and patiently, kept a close eye on my cat, and put me at ease during the appointment.
It's obvious she loves her job and animals.
The receptionist, Svetlana, is very friendly, kind, and professional. She tries to help you at all times and always answers all my questions.
It's wonderful to find people like that when you arrive at a clinic.
The clinic is right next to my house, and I'm so glad to have them so close.
Thank you for the wonderful, humane treatment!
Highly recommended!
Today Luna got her vaccinations, and Clara and Svetlana were incredibly professional, kind, and friendly—they made the visit a real pleasure! Thank you so much!
A real disappointment. This clinic was much better when Nacho was there; he cared more about the animals…
The service was very professional, and everything in general was excellent.

Unfortunately, I recently had to put my cat down (due to his age and because there was nothing else that could be done). I've never been one to see an animal suffer after all other options have been exhausted.
It's worth mentioning that he wasn't the first pet I've had to put down (I've had several throughout my life). My negative opinion of this clinic is based solely on my single visit (because I was new to the neighborhood and had good reviews on Google). That said, I've never witnessed such a "horrific" death with any of my previous pets, even though the vet insisted my cat wasn't suffering when he started convulsing after she "tried" to administer the medication intravenously. (She didn't find the vein properly, and still administered the medication.) After a while of convulsions (it felt like an eternity to me), she ended up inserting another IV in his other leg to administer more medication. In the end, he died. As I said, with ALL my previous pets (cats and dogs), their death was peaceful and "sweet"... (to put it mildly), but what I saw there, and the vet's coldness in telling me he wasn't suffering, is beyond words...

I will certainly never go back there, and obviously, I don't recommend it at all.

I've been taking my rabbit here for a few years now, and the service is truly outstanding. The vet is very kind to both us and her.
Whenever we've had a problem, they've been quick to help.
This clinic is a 10/10.

I took my cats to be spayed because they were the contact person at the animal shelter, and they did a great job. I don't take them there regularly because it's far away, but they are very kind and professional.

It has always been a pleasure taking them to this clinic. Due to a mistake, he was at another center, and we had a huge scare. A veterinarian sedated my pet, giving him a higher dose than he should have, causing him to go into cardiac arrest (he wasn't breathing, he was dying...). When I was at my worst, the only person I thought of turning to was Pablo, the owner of ACE Veterinary Clinic! He SAVED Simba!!! He told the other veterinarian what to give him, how to administer it, and what to do to save his life!
A true professional! I can never thank him enough!
We must take our animals to places that DO know how to treat them, and here it's clear that they care for them, attend to them, and fight for them! Because they have a true vocation for animals.

Thank you, Pablo, for everything you have done for Simba and for me.
I will always be eternally grateful ❤️
Outstanding service, professionals from head to toe, admirable gentleness with animals

Well, I went there because my trusted clinic in my previous neighborhood was taking too long to answer my calls.

I was taking my cat in for a checkup since I found him in the street. The phone service was excellent, and the in-person visit was incredibly professional. The two veterinarians who saw us were kind, empathetic, and very helpful.

The cat was microchipped, and they called the contact number. They even lent me a carrier because mine didn't close properly.

This was my first and only experience. If I get another pet that isn't exotic, I'll definitely go back to ACE, and I can say I would recommend them 100%.

This is the first time I've ever posted a review. But I'm writing this because I highly recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone looking for one. The two veterinarians there, Pablo and Nacho, are excellent, first as people and then as professionals. It was impossible to treat me better, but especially my cats. Their touch is superb, the way they handle them... you can tell they love their work and animals. They are exceptional. The two ladies who answer the phone are also very attentive, and when you arrive, they are incredibly polite and always try to find a solution. I can only congratulate them all; I recommend them 100%.
The staff were very friendly. And the doctor was very professional.
They are incredible professionals.
Excellent service to our Chiqui, thank you! 🫶 …
The vet who saw my dog ​​today is amazing. He reassured me by giving me his opinion on what to do next. Everyone at the clinic is wonderful!
